subject: design-technology
title: Inputs, Process, Output
welcome_lead: Every electronic system: input → process → output.
final_note: Sensors in, brains in middle, action out.

concepts.def: Action coming out — light, sound, motion.

walkthroughs.body_html: All electronic systems can be drawn as Input → Process → Output. Inputs feed sensor data. Process decides. Output acts. A nightlight is LDR (input) → micro:bit (process) → LED (output).
Inputs you'll meet: LDR (light), thermistor (heat), button (pressure), microphone (sound), PIR (movement). Each gives the process block info about the world.
Microcontrollers like Arduino and BBC micro:bit are tiny programmable computers. You write code that reads inputs and chooses outputs. Modern electronics is mostly this.
